speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeria monocytogenes infection (Listeriosis).

The distinctive tumbling motility of the Gram-positive rods you described is pathognomonic for Listeria monocytogenes. Given your pregnancy status and symptoms of fever and malaise, this is the most likely cause. I will immediately request images of the blood smear to confirm the findings before initiating targeted antibiotic therapy.
